envelope.description: Acquire and safely stage the official runtime

body.title: Acquire and safely stage the official runtime
body.summary: Implement bounded live official runtime/header/library download, digest verification and safe deterministic extraction in the proposed acquisition module. Produce only owned validated stages; close actors before cleanup and reuse the read-only verifier/profile rules without application payload access.
acceptanceChecks: Official assets are HTTPS/status/redirect/size/hash/deadline checked before extraction or target-code execution; POSIX and Windows profile extraction rejects unsafe/colliding/special entries and missing exact npm/header/library inputs.
Cancellation and download/extraction failure close network/parser resources before removing only the owned stage; uncertain closure retains evidence and fails.
Stage verification covers the fixed runtime limits and exact independent inventory digest; no runtime/release publication, selection or daemon lifecycle occurs in this staging task.
